MailMarlon01: Hello @,^Your grandfather and I were great friends. MailMarlon02: Hello @,^The other day I was sitting by a campfire, thinking about the adventures I shared with your grandfather.^It's a shame he isn't here to teach you his insect meat recipes. MailMarlon03: @, young warrior.^I found some supplies I used to carry on my adventures.^This snack may not look like much, but it's saved me from hunger more times than I can count.^I also found a small magnet ring. It'll make gathering loot a little easier while you're fighting.^^- Marlon.
MailMarlon04: Hello @,^I can see you've been making good progress in combat. Monsters seem to scatter whenever you enter the mines.^Your grandfather would be proud to see you now. MailMarlon05: @, my favorite adventurer.^I managed to get this totem for you.^If you ever need to get home quickly, just use it.
